'''Turbo-sledding''' was a winter sport. It was available on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]], where [[turbo-sled]]s could be rented from [[Ambar's Big Game, Tackle, and Gear Shop]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
